title: On the Eight-petalled Lotus
translation: Set upon the eight-petalled lotus, the cause of all creation, the linga that removes the eight kinds of poverty: I bow to that linga of Sadashiva.
translation_hi: जो अष्टदल कमल पर स्थित है, सबकी उत्पत्ति का कारण है, और आठ प्रकार की दरिद्रता का नाश करता है, उस सदाशिव लिंग को मैं प्रणाम करता हूँ।

words.note: dala = petal; also 'half' in the bee verse!
As in tad-upari in the peacock verse.

grammar: One word, two meanings: दल = petal here, and 'half' in Lilavati verse 3. The meaning comes from context.
Guna sandhi: अष्टदल + उपरि → अष्टदलोपरि, like तस्योपरि.
Refrain: तत्प्रणमामि सदाशिवलिङ्गम् 'I bow to that linga of Sadashiva.'
